excerpt: The Climate Data Journalism Workshop | Bhopal Edition The first of its kind workshop on climate change, data journalism, visualisation and verification Azim Premji University in collaboration with IndiaSpend brings to you the Climate Data Journalism Workshop. The workshop aims to provide journalists with the basic tools and skill-sets to report on climate change and build India’s first cohort of climate change journalists. Participants will learn how to build data-backed and evidence-based narratives, tools to detect misinformation and disinformation and visualise stories. By the end of this two-day certificate course, reporters will be better prepared to write data stories and will gain an insight to best practices while reporting on climate change. Registration fee There is a registration fee for the workshop of INR 472. Limited seats available. In case of any queries, please write to climatedatajournalismworkshops@indiaspend.org
